label: GO step after an unrewarded trial (early/mid episode)
explanation: Fires only at GO (100% of mass; never at D1, essentially never at D2). Strongly gated by the previous trial being unrewarded (prev_reward 0: 89% of mass, rate 11% vs 1.7% after reward), and switches off late in the episode (no activity after ep_trial ~70, a slow drift in hidden state rather than a task variable). Magnitude is larger when the agent is about to choose a1 (top quartile 97% covered by adding action==1, which the agent computes itself) and after runs of consecutive unrewarded trials; weaker on a2 choices. Active steps concentrate in the upper-middle value bin (7.7-8.1) and at strongly positive choice logits. Predicate (GO & prev unrewarded & ep_trial<65) uses only observed variables; dev F1 0.60, mass recall 0.89; adding value>7.6 gives only F1 0.63. Precision is limited: many GO steps after no reward, especially a2 choices, do not fire.
